messages:
Maya (People Ops): hey folks / quick question: Owen started Oct 20 and missed our regional Juneteenth floating day. Manager asked if we can credit him 1 floating day to PTO as a goodwill exception. Also he's requesting to take that day during our performance calibration blackout in early Jan. Thoughts?

Owen (Eng): i'd appreciate it but i can also swap with teammate. hoping for the credit so it's on my balance.

Priya (Manager): i can approve the credit if People Ops ok. For blackout week i need him present for calibration; can he take a different day? if not, we can approve a single-day exception but he must be available remotely for his slot.

PeopleOps Bot: policy reminder: floating holidays expire at year-end and are not normally convertible. Exceptions allowed with manager approval + People Ops exception record. Blackout exceptions require manager justification and must be logged as CAL_BLOCK exception.

Maya (People Ops): thanks. Proposed process:
1) Priya posts approval in thread.
2) We file EXC-2025-201 and add +1 PTO day on 01/02 (after blackout ends) OR allow same-day swap.
3) If taking during blackout, require confirmation they'll attend calibration remotely.

Priya (Manager): approve conversion of 1 floating day to PTO for Owen Z. I will ensure he swaps coverage if he cannot attend calibration in person.

Maya (People Ops): thanks Priya. Owen, please confirm you'll attend your calibration slot remotely if you take the day in blackout week.

Owen (Eng): confirm i'll be online for my calibration slot if i take the day.

Maya (People Ops): filing EXC-2025-201 now and scheduling HRIS update. Jasper, can you run: hrcli adjust-balance --user owen.z --add 1 --type PTO --note "Floating holiday exception EXC-2025-201" on 2025-01-02?

PeopleOps Bot: Action created: EXC-2025-201. Link: https://redwood.example/hr/exceptions/EXC-2025-201

Kyle (Payroll): FYI no payroll impact for one-time PTO credit. All good.

Maya (People Ops): done / HRIS scheduled. Closing thread — reminder to managers: prefer swaps over credits during blackout to keep balances clean. :white_check_mark:
